title: Spruce
body:
Description

The Spruce is a common tree found abundantly around Finlay Island. It is identified by its less-saturated brown bark and dark green leaves. It takes on a tall and slender shape, standing about 35–40 studs tall, making it one of the tallest trees. Its trunk stands tall and thin, nearly completely uncurved, but its leaves span out far, making the whole of the tree quite wide compared to most others.

The normal barked tree sells for around $1.5 per stud, but its sell price increases to $22.5 per stud when sanded, and $25 per stud when planked.

As with any other material in the game, logged, sanded, and planked Spruce can be used to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Spruce has a similar appearance to the Blue Pine, but it is much shorter and has a darker brown bark.
